description: Audit a whole dependency list in one call: up to 200 exact npm, PyPI, crates or Go package versions checked against OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities and malware. Returns which packages are affected, severity, fixed versions and an overall verdict. Price: $0.02 in USDC per call (x402 or prepaid credits). In the free trial.
